items.name: Dutch Open 2017

venue.name: [Sint-Maartenscollege](http://www.st-maartenscollege.nl/)
venue.address: Aart van der Leeuwkade 14, 2274 KX Voorburg

items.information:
Dutch Open has been a tradition since 2003. So this is the 15th edition.

Saturday: side events.
Sunday: main events and Dutch Cube Day 2017.

All competitors and guests must be registered.
Maximum one guest per competitor. Please do not register guests unless really necessary. We prefer more competitors to more guests.
Maximum of 80 persons per day (competitors and guests).

Fee per competitor and per guest
- Saturday: 6 EUR including lunch/cake/drinks
- Sunday: 16 EUR including lunch/cake/drinks (NKC members 11 EUR)
You can pay the fee during on-site registration at the competition.
